title: 🎥 Watch if you need a reset!
transcript: It's very important to have a break from your regular routine. You're probably highly motivated individual grinding hard all the time. I'm currently here on vacation and it's just a great time to reset and have a break, enjoy time with family. You know, it's a time to reflect on what you're doing, how you're getting on. And the best part is is that you get, you know, really good insights when you're relaxed, when you're enjoying the moment, and you don't necessarily have to reward yourself at the end. Taking breaks along the way and enjoying life is all part of the process. So whether it's trading or you're stuck in different parts of your career, take a break, relax, reset, and get back even stronger.
